items.description: Unknown routes return HTTP 404 and a JSON error; the service must still answer /health after an unknown request.
npm start listens on process.env.PORT (default 3000); exported server factory is separate from the executable startup file.
npm test runs real HTTP tests on an ephemeral loopback port checking health, unknown route, and health again, then closes the server; no HTTP mocks.
npm run build checks all source JavaScript syntax; deliver package.json, source, tests, and README with instructions and a source-to-requirement mapping; consistent CommonJS .cjs conventions.
Stateless service using only built-in http and node:test; no database, Docker, identity provider, third-party packages, or cloud infrastructure.
Startup entry component creates the application and listens on PORT (diagram: Startup --> Application).
Exported HTTP server factory component (diagram: Application) used by both startup and tests.
Real ephemeral-port tests component (diagram: Tests) creates the application on a loopback random port.
Client sends GET /health or an unknown route to the application (diagram: Client --> Application).
